text:
maya: Heads up — onboarding ACME Edge (enterprise). Need GPU quota increases in eu-south-1: p5 family (p5.48xlarge) x12, g5 family (g5.24xlarge) x8. Also need ENI / IP limits bumped for the customer VPC. Can someone kick off the AWS quota requests + TAM escalation? Need this cleared before next Tue. Thanks.

alex: Quick Q — do we have any existing reservations or placement groups for eu-south-1? p5s can be scarce. I can check capacity and open the SRs, but want to confirm the exact AZ spread.

maya: No reservations yet. Customer wants cross-AZ redundancy (3 AZs). Spread the p5s across azs if possible.

sam: FYI finance asked for a rough monthly cost estimate to include in the SOW. Can we drop a ballpark?

maya: Ballpark: p5.48x ~ $40/hr (on-demand) *12 *24*30 =~ $345,600/mo ; g5.24x ~ $12/hr *8 *24*30 =~ $69,120/mo. Total on-demand ~ $415k/mo. This is rough — dedicated pricing / committed capacity will change it a lot. :grimacing:

alex: I'll file two AWS support requests: one for "Running On-Demand p5.48xlarge instances" quota and one for "g5.24xlarge" quota, plus a third for network limits (ENI / IPv4 addresses). Use this template when creating SRs:

```
Service: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (ec2)
Region: eu-south-1
Limit: Running On-Demand p5.48xlarge instances
Current value: 0
Requested value: 12
Use case: Production inference fleet for ACME Edge, cross-AZ for redundancy. Low-latency inference workload with NCCL/EFA enabled. Contact: maya@redwood.ai
```

And for network: 
```
Service: Amazon VPC / EC2
Region: eu-south-1
Limit: Elastic Network Interfaces per VPC / per instance
Current value: 50 (example)
Requested value: 500
Use case: Each GPU instance will attach multiple ENIs/EFA; need higher quota for onboarding and pod density.
```

Also paste the internal runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbook/gpu-quotas (include TAM escalation steps).

maya: Thanks — please include request to enable EFA for the account and confirm if EBS throughput quotas need bumps too.

alex: Filed SRs. AWS SR IDs: 1234567891 (p5 quota), 1234567892 (g5 quota), 1234567893 (network/ENI). Created internal Jira INFRA-4821 tracking the requests. I also pinged our TAM.

infra-bot: Created INFRA-4821 and assigned to alex. SLA: 72h internal tracking.

liam: Important — we need Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) enabled and the ENI quotas that EFA uses. When you open the SR, ask AWS to validate EFA on p5 in the AZs we requested.

alex: Good call. I added: "Please validate EFA support and availability for p5 in eu-south-1 AZs and confirm any required AMI/driver steps."

sam: Thanks. Once AWS confirms, how quickly can we spin up reserved capacity? Sales wants a date estimate for the SOW.

alex: If AWS approves quota + we get TAM confirmation, we can request a short-term capacity reservation (1 week) while we finalize purchase. Best-case timeline ~ 7–10 business days, depends on AZ capacity. I'll push for faster.

maya: Perfect. Keep me updated here and drop the SR links when AWS replies. I'll hold the onboarding checklist until quotas are green.

alex: Will do. Tagging @ops-followup internally when we have SR responses.

maya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
